{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling any non-numeric values
# Remove currency symbol and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the conversion
revenue_dtypes = sales_df['revenue'].dtype
revenue_summary = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

# Confirm no issues
revenue_dtypes, revenue_summary"}
